svg.title: SNOW Projects and Time - How to use this report
svg.text: SNOW Projects & Time: How to use this report
Created by ABS Data & Analytics Team. Data: ServiceNow PPM and time cards (bronze_servicenow), refreshed with the dataset.
PM-reported status by project, with financials and unposted time. Badge column first; worst first.
Drill-through: right-click a project > Drill through > Project Health. Status-check tiles + action items with owners.
Project time cards not yet posted to cost ($110/hr), split by status, with who owns each action.
Demand pipeline; idle demands by assignee and PM; the table lists who should update each demand.
INDICATORS (SHAPE AND SYMBOL CARRY THE MEANING, SO THEY READ WITHOUT COLOR)
Tiles: badge + amount + who acts. Tables and cards use red / amber / green fills;
charts use the color-blind palette (orange = needs attention, navy, slate). Hover ? on any visual for its rule.
PM-REPORTED STATUS IS THE HEADLINE; CALCULATED VALUES ARE CHECKS
Health = the color the PM sets in ServiceNow. Calc Differs counts projects where SPI, CPI or the PMO guideline gives another color.
Badge column: red = PM reports Red, or a calculation is Red and the PM does not show it; amber = PM Yellow or a calculation differs; green = all agree.
SPI = % complete / % of time used (0.90+ On Track, 0.75 to 0.90 At Risk, under 0.75 Behind). CPI = earned value (budget x % complete) / posted cost.
PMO RAG GUIDELINE AND CHECKS (SCOPE AND RESOURCES = PM JUDGMENT; NOT MEASURABLE FROM SERVICENOW)
Slip of 20%+ of the approved duration (end date moved past baseline, past due, or projected from % complete vs time used)
Slip of 10% to 20% of the approved duration, or a milestone past due
Estimate at completion 20%+ over the approved budget (CapEx + OpEx); cost includes unposted time
Estimate at completion 10% to 20% over budget, or spend with no approved budget
Open Critical issue, open issue 14+ days past due, or high/absolute risk with no mitigation
Any open issue, an open risk past due, or an open high/absolute risk
End date moved without a change request
End date moved more than 10% of the approved duration past the approved end date, with no schedule change request on file
Calculated SPI color, CPI color or guideline rating is not the PM-reported color
3+ open tasks past due, or 15%+ of open tasks past due (input to the PM's Resources judgment)
The ServiceNow status update field is empty
Project time cards 14+ days old that never posted an expense line ($110/hr)
A time card posted more than one expense line
% complete is 40+ points ahead of % of time used
No approved end date, or approved budget is $0
UNPOSTED TIME: STATUS AND WHO OWNS THE ACTION
One approver (usually the PM) approved; waiting on the other (usually the line manager). Owner: that approver.
Submitted; no approver has acted yet. Owner: the approvers on the card.
No approver routed in ServiceNow. Owner: PMO.
Fully approved but no expense line. Owner: ServiceNow admin (reprocess).
Draft time never submitted. Owner: the employee.
Two expense lines for one card ($220/hr). Owner: Finance (reverse the duplicate).
Budget = CapEx + OpEx on the ServiceNow project. Actual = posted work cost. EAC = cost to date (incl. unposted time) / % complete.
Unposted time = project time cards with no expense line, at the $110/hr blended rate. ABS ... Operations ticket buckets are excluded everywhere.
Since June 2026 project time cards need two approvals (PM and the person's line manager); a card posts only after both approve.
